title: api-config-shape-scratchpad-morgan
content:
Notes to self: sketching API/config shape for route-level inference policies and runtime hints. Quick context: this is a user-facing config that lives in project repo and is consumed by the control plane to create route configs for hosted/dedicated/private. Keep small, readable, and hackable.

Goals:
- Single source route config that maps to runtime decisions (model variant, batching, cache, quant profile, fallback).
- Human-editable YAML/JSON for infra + programmatic override via API.
- Default-first: minimal required fields, sensible defaults.

High-level candidate shape (YAML-like):
route: my-app/generate-reply
model: redwood/llama-rtl-v2
model_version: v1.3.0
capacity_tier: standard  # standard | high | dedicated
latency_slo_ms: 150
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_tokens_per_batch: 4096
  max_concurrent_batches: 8
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 300
quantization_profile: q3_k_mixed  # suggestions from Optimize service
rollout_policy:
  strategy: canary
  canary_percentage: 10
  monitoring: ["latency_ms", "p95_tokens", "quality_regression_score"]
fallbacks:
  - model: redwood/llama-rtl-v2-quant
  - model: redwood/llama-rtl-v1

Route-level request/response API sketch for control-plane: POST /v1/routes {route_config} -> returns route_id + validation report.
Validation should include: model compatibility with quant profile, estimated cost per 1k tokens, expected latency band given historical traces, and warnings if rollout policy lacks monitoring hooks.

Example JSON Schema (rough) included inline as text for discussion; will formalize in PR: { type: object, required: ["route", "model"], properties: { route: {type: string}, model: {type: string}, model_version: {type: string}, capacity_tier: {enum: ["standard", "high", "dedicated"]}, latency_slo_ms: {type: integer} } }

Operational notes / runtime hints:
- Kernel selection hints can be optional string tags (e.g., "flash_attn_v2") that will be mapped to compiled kernel sets at serving time.
- Expose a small set of tuning knobs to users: batching.enabled, batching.max_batch_latency_ms. Longer tail of options hidden behind Optimize suggestions.
- Prefix KV cache should be opt-in per-route because semantics can cause cache leakage across tenants if misconfigured. Default true for public routes.

Open questions / TODOs:
- How to represent prompt templates and prompt-level eval hooks in the config? Inline template or reference to stored prompt id? (leaning towards id reference).
- Do we allow per-route user-defined eval sets for quality regression alerts or only packaged evals from Optimize?
- Authorization model for editing route configs in shared repos (branch + PR checks + signed approvals).
- Validation thresholds: what is the gating behavior for canary -> ramp? automatic vs manual?

Next steps:
- Sync with Jamie on page that lists quant profiles and kernel tags. (ACTION: JP)
- Draft control-plane API spec for POST/GET/PUT route configs and share in GH PR. (ACTION: Casey)
- Add example of prompt-template ref and small telemetry schema for monitoring.

Quick references:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-API-CONFIG-23 (design doc)
- GH: GH-PR-482 (initial api code)
- Jira: JIRA-INF-1012 (validation engine epic)

Rough notes ended. This is intentionally messy — keep as a scratchpad before moving to a formal PR doc.
